title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,451–1,500 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: Almost every adult in Taiwan owns a high-speed smartphone.
examples.zh: 台灣幾乎每位成年人都擁有一支高速智慧型手機。

examples.en: She uses her smartphone to scan QR codes for quick mobile payments.
examples.zh: 她使用智慧型手機掃描 QR Code 進行快速行動支付。

examples.en: Excessive smartphone use before bedtime can disrupt your natural sleep cycle.
examples.zh: 睡前過度使用智慧型手機會干擾你的自然睡眠週期。

examples.en: Tap the interactive touchscreen to place your fast food order.
examples.zh: 輕觸互動式觸控螢幕以點選速食餐點。

examples.en: Modern subway ticket kiosks feature multi-language touchscreens.
examples.zh: 現代地鐵售票機配有支援多國語言的觸控螢幕。

examples.en: Use a soft microfiber cloth to wipe fingerprints off the touchscreen.
examples.zh: 使用柔軟的超細纖維布擦拭觸控螢幕上的指紋。

examples.en: She uses a digital tablet and stylus pen to draw illustrations.
examples.zh: 她使用數位平板電腦和觸控筆繪製插畫。

examples.en: The flight attendants handed out entertainment tablets to first-class passengers.
examples.zh: 空服員向頭等艙旅客發放機上娛樂平板電腦。

examples.en: Swallow one calcium tablet each morning with fresh orange juice.
examples.zh: 每天早晨配新鮮柳橙汁吞服一顆鈣片藥錠。

examples.en: Download the Taipei Bus app to check real-time arrival estimates.
examples.zh: 下載台北公車 App 以查詢即時預估到站時間。

examples.en: This language-learning app sends daily vocabulary reminders to your lock screen.
examples.zh: 這款語言學習 App 每天會發送單字提醒至你的鎖定畫面。

examples.en: Developers released a major app update to fix bugs and improve performance.
examples.zh: 開發團隊發布了重大的 App 更新以修復漏洞並提升效能。

examples.en: Install the latest security update to protect your personal data.
examples.zh: 安裝最新的安全性更新以保護個人資料。

examples.en: A licensed technician came to install our high-speed fiber internet.
examples.zh: 一名合格技師前來安裝我們的高速光纖寬頻網路。

examples.en: It takes only a few seconds to install this lightweight mobile application.
examples.zh: 安裝這款輕量型手機應用程式僅需短短幾秒鐘。

examples.en: Keep your smartphone operating system updated regularly.
examples.zh: 定期更新您的智慧型手機作業系統。

examples.en: The project manager sent a weekly progress update to all stakeholders.
examples.zh: 專案經理向所有利害關係人寄送了每週進度更新報告。

examples.en: Weather forecasts are updated every hour during typhoon season.
examples.zh: 颱風季節期間天氣預報每小時都會進行更新。

examples.en: Turn off app notifications during study hours to avoid distraction.
examples.zh: 讀書時間關閉 App 推播通知以避免分心。

examples.en: You will receive an instant push notification when your package arrives.
examples.zh: 當您的包裹送達時，您將會收到一則即時推播通知。

examples.en: The university posted an official notification regarding holiday campus closures.
examples.zh: 大學發布了關於連假期間校園閉館的正式公告通知。

examples.en: Go to phone settings to adjust your screen brightness.
examples.zh: 進入手機設定選單以調整螢幕亮度。

examples.en: You can manage your privacy settings to restrict who views your profile.
examples.zh: 您可以管理隱私權設定，限制誰能檢視您的個人檔案。

examples.en: Reset the router to its factory default settings to clear network errors.
examples.zh: 將路由器恢復原廠預設設定以排除網路設定錯誤。

examples.en: Free public Wi-Fi is accessible across Taipei MRT stations.
examples.zh: 台北捷運各站均提供免費公共 Wi-Fi 無線上網。

examples.en: Could you tell me the password for the cafe Wi-Fi network?
examples.zh: 請問能告訴我這家咖啡館的 Wi-Fi 無線網路密碼嗎？

examples.en: The laptop automatically reconnected to the home Wi-Fi upon opening.
examples.zh: 一打開螢幕，筆記型電腦就自動重新連上了家中的 Wi-Fi。

examples.en: Can you turn on your mobile hotspot so I can share your data?
examples.zh: 你能開啟手機行動熱點讓我分享網路嗎？

examples.en: The night market is a renowned tourist hotspot for authentic street food.
examples.zh: 這座夜市是品嚐道地街頭美食的著名觀光熱門景點。

examples.en: Using your smartphone as a personal hotspot drains battery life quickly.
examples.zh: 將智慧型手機作為個人熱點使用會快速消耗電池電量。

examples.en: Turn on Bluetooth to pair your wireless earbuds with your phone.
examples.zh: 開啟藍牙以將無線耳機與手機進行配對。

examples.en: Bluetooth technology allows fast wireless audio transmission over short distances.
examples.zh: 藍牙技術允許在短距離內進行快速的無線音訊傳輸。

examples.en: Many modern cars connect seamlessly to smartphones via hands-free Bluetooth.
examples.zh: 許多現代汽車透過免持藍牙技術與智慧型手機無縫連線。

examples.en: Pair your smartwatch with your health app.
examples.zh: 將您的智慧手錶與健康 App 進行配對。

examples.en: She bought a stylish pair of black leather boots for winter.
examples.zh: 她為冬天買了一雙時髦亮麗的黑色真皮靴。

examples.en: The teacher asked students to pair up for the conversational role-play.
examples.zh: 老師要求學生們兩人一組進行會話角色扮演練習。

examples.en: Connect your laptop to the classroom projector with an HDMI cable.
examples.zh: 用 HDMI 傳輸線將筆電連接至教室投影機。

examples.en: High-speed rail lines connect major western coastal cities across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 高鐵路線將台灣西部各大主要沿海城市連成一氣。

examples.en: Social networking services help old friends stay connected across continents.
examples.zh: 社群網路服務幫助老朋友跨越大洲維持緊密聯繫。

examples.en: The video call disconnected abruptly due to poor signal.
examples.zh: 由於訊號不良，視訊通話突然中斷連線。

examples.en: Always disconnect electrical appliances before cleaning or maintenance.
examples.zh: 在清潔或維護保養前，請務必先拔除切斷家電電源。

examples.en: Taking a weekend camping trip helps you disconnect from work stress.
examples.zh: 來一趟週末露營之旅有助於讓你暫時抽離工作壓力。

examples.en: My phone battery is down to five percent; I need to charge it.
examples.zh: 我手機電量只剩下 5%，我需要充電了。

examples.en: Electric vehicles run on rechargeable lithium-ion battery packs.
examples.zh: 電動車仰賴可重複充電的鋰離子電池模組運轉。

examples.en: The smoke detector beeped repeatedly to indicate a low battery.
examples.zh: 煙霧偵測器反覆發出嗶嗶聲，提示電池電量不足。

examples.en: This laptop has an impressive twelve-hour battery life.
examples.zh: 這款筆記型電腦擁有長達十二小時的優異電池續航力。

examples.en: Lowering screen brightness can significantly extend your smartphone's battery life.
examples.zh: 調低螢幕亮度可以顯著延長智慧型手機的電池續航時間。

examples.en: Over time, frequent overcharging can degrade overall battery life.
examples.zh: 隨著時間推移，頻繁過度充電會損耗整體電池的壽命與續航力。

examples.en: Did anyone bring a USB-C phone charger I can borrow?
examples.zh: 有人帶了可以借我用的 Type-C 手機充電器嗎？

examples.en: Don't leave your phone charger plugged into the wall outlet overnight.
examples.zh: 切勿將手機充電器插在壁插上整夜不拔。

examples.en: Fast chargers can power up modern smartphone batteries to 80% in half an hour.
examples.zh: 快速充電器能在半小時內將現代智慧型手機電池充至 80%。

examples.en: Always carry a fully charged power bank when traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊時請隨身攜帶充飽電的行動電源。

examples.en: Airline safety rules prohibit placing power banks in checked baggage.
examples.zh: 航空安全法規嚴格禁止將行動電源放入託運行李中。

examples.en: This compact power bank can recharge a smartphone up to three times.
examples.zh: 這款輕巧型行動電源可為智慧型手機完整充電多達三次。

examples.en: Use a durable braided charging cable to avoid fraying.
examples.zh: 使用耐用的編織充電傳輸線以防止磨損斷裂。

examples.en: Undersea fiber-optic cables carry massive amounts of international internet traffic.
examples.zh: 海底光纖電纜乘載著龐大巨量的國際網際網路傳輸量。

examples.en: The cable television network offers dozens of international news channels.
examples.zh: 有線電視網絡提供了數十個國際新聞頻道。

examples.en: Save your presentation slides on a portable USB flash drive.
examples.zh: 將你的簡報投影片儲存於隨身攜帶的 USB 隨身碟中。

examples.en: He plugged the flash drive into the desktop computer to transfer files.
examples.zh: 他把隨身碟插進桌上型電腦以進行檔案傳輸。

examples.en: Encrypt sensitive documents stored on your USB flash drive for protection.
examples.zh: 為儲存在 USB 隨身碟中的機密文件進行加密以獲得保護。

examples.en: Noise-canceling headphones help you concentrate in noisy cafes.
examples.zh: 抗噪耳罩式耳機有助於在吵雜的咖啡廳中集中注意力。

examples.en: He placed his over-ear headphones on the desk after the podcast recording.
examples.zh: 播客錄音結束後，他將耳罩式耳機平放在辦公桌上。

examples.en: Wear stereo headphones to appreciate the subtle details of classical music.
examples.zh: 戴上立體聲耳機以細細品味古典樂細緻精妙的音質層次。

words.definition: 無線藍牙耳機；入耳式耳機

examples.en: Wireless earbuds are lightweight and convenient for jogging.
examples.zh: 無線藍牙耳機輕巧便攜，慢跑時佩戴非常方便。

examples.en: She lost one of her wireless earbuds while rushing onto the subway train.
examples.zh: 她在匆忙衝上捷運列車時不慎弄丟了一隻無線耳機。

examples.en: Keep your earbuds in their charging case when not in use to avoid losing them.
examples.zh: 未使用時請將耳機放回充電盒內，以防不慎遺失。

examples.en: Please speak directly into the microphone so everyone can hear.
examples.zh: 請對著麥克風說話，以便大家都聽得清楚。

examples.en: The host adjusted the height of the podium microphone before speaking.
examples.zh: 主持人在發言前微調了講台麥克風的高度。

examples.en: Studio condenser microphones capture crystal-clear vocal recordings.
examples.zh: 錄音室等級的電容式麥克風能捕捉清澈透亮的純淨人聲。

examples.en: Mute your microphone when you are not speaking in online meetings.
examples.zh: 線上視訊會議未發言時請將麥克風設為靜音。

examples.en: Press the mute button on the TV remote during loud commercials.
examples.zh: 在吵鬧的廣告時段按下電視遙控器上的靜音鍵。

examples.en: He stared in mute shock when hearing the unbelievable news.
examples.zh: 聽到這起令人難以置信的消息時，他震驚得啞口無言。

examples.en: Turn down the TV volume; baby is taking a nap.
examples.zh: 把電視音量調小一點，小寶寶正在睡午覺。

examples.en: The sales volume of electric scooters hit an all-time high last quarter.
examples.zh: 電動機車的銷售量在上一季創下了歷史新高。

examples.en: This comprehensive encyclopedia consists of twelve thick leather volumes.
examples.zh: 這套完備的百科全書一共由十二本厚實的精裝卷冊組成。

examples.en: Tap the red icon on the screen to record a video.
examples.zh: 輕觸螢幕上的紅色圖示以錄製影片。

examples.en: Don't forget to turn off the bathroom water tap tightly.
examples.zh: 別忘了將浴室的水龍頭確實關緊。

examples.en: He tapped gently on the wooden office door before entering.
examples.zh: 他在進入辦公室前在木門上輕輕敲了幾下。

examples.en: Swipe left to view the next photo in the album.
examples.zh: 向左滑動以查看相簿中的下一張照片。

examples.en: Simply swipe your staff ID badge across the sensor to unlock the office door.
examples.zh: 只需在感應器上刷一下員工證即可解鎖辦公室大門。

examples.en: The curious cat swiped its paw playfully at the dangling string.
examples.zh: 好奇的小貓伸出爪子頑皮地撥弄著懸掛的細線。

examples.en: Scroll down to the bottom of the page to submit your application.
examples.zh: 向下滾動至頁面最底部以提交你的申請。

examples.en: Many users mindlessly scroll through social media feeds for hours.
examples.zh: 許多使用者漫無目的地滑著社群動態數小時之久。

examples.en: Ancient scholars preserved sacred philosophical teachings on papyrus scrolls.
examples.zh: 古代學者將神聖的哲學教義保存在莎草紙卷軸上。

examples.en: Pinch out on the touchscreen to zoom in on the map details.
examples.zh: 在觸控螢幕上向外雙指推開以放大地圖細節。

examples.en: The photographer zoomed in to capture the hummingbird sipping nectar.
examples.zh: 攝影師拉近變焦鏡頭以捕捉蜂鳥吮吸花蜜的瞬間。

examples.en: Let's zoom in on this specific marketing problem to find a root cause.
examples.zh: 讓我們聚焦放大深入探討這項具體的行銷難題以找出根本原因。

examples.en: Zoom out to see the entire Taiwan railway route network.
examples.zh: 縮小畫面以檢視全台灣鐵路路線全圖。

examples.en: The director zoomed out to show the vast, solitary desert surrounding the traveler.
examples.zh: 導演將鏡頭拉遠縮小，呈現出圍繞著旅人的遼闊孤寂荒漠。

examples.en: Sometimes we need to zoom out and evaluate the big picture objectively.
examples.zh: 有時候我們需要拉遠視角，客觀審視整體大局發展。

examples.en: Click the blue button to confirm your airline seat selection.
examples.zh: 點擊藍色按鈕以確認您的飛機劃位選擇。

examples.en: The key turned in the lock with a satisfying click.
examples.zh: 鑰匙在鎖孔中轉動，發出了一聲令人安心的喀噠聲。

examples.en: As soon as they met, their personalities just clicked right away.
examples.zh: 他們倆一見面，彼此的個性立刻一拍即合、非常投緣。

examples.en: Click on the hyperlink to read the full news article.
examples.zh: 點擊超連結以閱讀完整的新聞報導。

examples.en: Blue underlined text usually indicates an active web hyperlink.
examples.zh: 藍色帶底線的文字通常表示這是一個可點選的網路超連結。

examples.en: The digital textbook includes hyperlinks directly connecting to external reference videos.
examples.zh: 這本數位教材包含直接連至外部參考教學影片的超連結。

examples.en: Book your train tickets on the official Taiwan Railways website.
examples.zh: 在台鐵官方網站上預訂您的火車票。

examples.en: The company redesigned its corporate website to be mobile-friendly.
examples.zh: 該公司重新設計了企業官網，使其更適合手機行動裝置瀏覽。

examples.en: You can find comprehensive course syllabi posted on the university website.
examples.zh: 您可以在大學官方網站上找到公告的完整課程大綱。

examples.en: Google Chrome and Safari are widely used web browsers.
examples.zh: Google Chrome 與 Safari 是被廣泛使用的網路瀏覽器。

examples.en: Clear your internet browser cache if a website fails to load properly.
examples.zh: 若網站無法正常載入，請試著清理您的網路瀏覽器快取。

examples.en: Bookworms and browsers enjoyed wandering through the shelves of the second-hand bookstore.
examples.zh: 愛書人與隨興翻閱的瀏覽客們享受穿梭在二手書店書架間的樂趣。

examples.en: Google is the most widely utilized search engine globally.
examples.zh: Google 是全球使用最廣泛的網路搜尋引擎。

examples.en: Search engines use complex algorithms to deliver relevant ranking results.
examples.zh: 搜尋引擎使用複雜演算法來呈現高度相關的排序搜尋結果。

examples.en: Optimizing website content helps improve visibility on popular search engines.
examples.zh: 最佳化網站內容有助於提升在主流搜尋引擎上的曝光能見度。

examples.en: Type relevant keywords into the search bar to find answers quickly.
examples.zh: 在搜尋列輸入相關關鍵字以迅速找到解答。

examples.en: Identifying effective keywords is critical for running successful search ad campaigns.
examples.zh: 找出高效精準的關鍵字對於投放成功的搜尋廣告至關重要。

examples.en: Underline keywords in the reading passage to assist in summarizing paragraphs.
examples.zh: 在閱讀短文中畫出重點關鍵字，有助於概括歸納段落大意。

examples.en: Instagram and Threads are trending social media platforms among youth.
examples.zh: Instagram 和 Threads 是在年輕人之間極具人氣的社群平台。

examples.en: Businesses leverage social media marketing to engage directly with consumers.
examples.zh: 企業善用社群媒體行銷與廣大消費者直接建立互動。

examples.en: Taking a break from social media can greatly benefit your mental health.
examples.zh: 適度遠離社群媒體暫時休息能為心理健康帶來莫大益處。

examples.en: She posted stunning photos of the Taitung hot air balloon festival.
examples.zh: 她在社群上發布了台東熱氣球嘉年華的絕美照片。

examples.en: Don't post sensitive personal identity information on public forums.
examples.zh: 切勿在公開網路論壇上發布敏感的個人身分資料。

examples.en: He leaned tiredly against the wooden lamppost waiting for his bus.
examples.zh: 他疲憊地靠在木製街燈燈柱上等候公車。

examples.en: Leave a friendly comment below if you enjoyed the vlog!
examples.zh: 如果你喜歡這部生活 Vlog，請在下方留下友善的留言！

examples.en: The government minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation.
examples.zh: 政府部會首長對目前正在進行中的調查案婉拒置評發表評論。

examples.en: Her constructive comments helped the author polish the book chapter.
examples.zh: 她富有建設性的點評意見幫助作者潤飾了書稿章節。

examples.en: Share this helpful English learning guide with your classmates.
examples.zh: 將這份實用的英語學習指南轉發分享給你的同班同學。

examples.en: The two sisters always share their snacks and favorite toys.
examples.zh: 這對姊妹總是互相分享彼此的零食小吃與心愛玩具。

examples.en: Tech shares rose sharply following news of impressive quarterly earnings.
examples.zh: 在公布亮眼的季度財報消息後，科技類股股價應聲大漲。

examples.en: Don't forget to hit like and subscribe to our channel!
examples.zh: 別忘了按讚並訂閱我們的頻道！

examples.en: Her latest travel photo album garnered thousands of likes within an hour.
examples.zh: 她最新的旅行相簿在一小時內就收穫了數千個讚。

examples.en: Like his father, he has a profound passion for classical literature.
examples.zh: 就像他的父親一樣，他對古典文學懷抱著無比深沉的熱情。

examples.en: Over a million fans subscribed to his educational YouTube channel.
examples.zh: 超過百萬名粉絲訂閱了他的教育類 YouTube 頻道。

examples.en: We subscribed to the digital edition of the international economics daily.
examples.zh: 我們訂閱了該國際經濟日報的電子數位版。

examples.en: I do not subscribe to the theory that failure is inevitable.
examples.zh: 我並不同意失敗無可避免的那種消極觀點。

examples.en: Streaming services like Netflix operate on monthly subscriptions.
examples.zh: 像 Netflix 這樣的串流影音平台採月費訂閱制營運。

examples.en: Cancel unwanted app subscriptions to avoid recurring credit card charges.
examples.zh: 取消不再使用的 App 訂閱服務以避免每月的信用卡自動扣款。

examples.en: The digital magazine subscription includes full access to historic archive articles.
examples.zh: 訂閱該數位雜誌享有不受限檢視歷史過刊資料庫的完整權限。

examples.en: The fashion creator gained 50,000 new followers this month.
examples.zh: 這位時尚創作者本月增加了五萬名新追蹤者。

examples.en: Confucius had thousands of devoted followers who recorded his philosophical teachings.
examples.zh: 孔子擁有數千名忠誠門生追隨者，記錄下了他的哲學思想。

examples.en: She is a loyal follower of indie rock music and attends every live gig.
examples.zh: 她是獨立搖滾音樂的忠實追隨支持者，場場現場演出都不缺席。

examples.en: The band broadcasted a live stream concert for global fans.
examples.zh: 該樂團為全球粉絲舉辦了一場線上直播演唱會。

examples.en: Thousands of viewers joined the live stream to ask real-time questions.
examples.zh: 數千名觀眾湧入線上直播間進行即時提問互動。

examples.en: The chef cooked braised beef noodles during an interactive live stream session.
examples.zh: 主廚在互動式直播節目中親自示範烹煮紅燒牛肉麵。

examples.en: The funny dancing cat video went viral on TikTok overnight.
examples.zh: 那支搞笑的跳舞貓咪影片在一夜之間在 TikTok 上瘋傳爆紅。

examples.en: The marketing campaign went viral, attracting millions of organic website visits.
examples.zh: 這次的行銷宣傳活動迅速爆紅瘋傳，吸引了數百萬自然網站訪問人次。

examples.en: Doctors treated the child for a mild seasonal viral infection.
examples.zh: 醫生為這位孩童治療了輕微的季節性病毒感染。

examples.en: Brands partner with food influencers to review new menu dishes.
examples.zh: 品牌業者與美食網紅合作開箱評測新菜單料理。

examples.en: Travel influencers share hidden local gems and budget travel tips online.
examples.zh: 旅遊網紅在網路上分享私房在地秘境與省錢旅遊撇步。

examples.en: Becoming an ethical influencer requires honesty about sponsored promotional content.
examples.zh: 成為一位具有職業道德的網紅，必須對業配贊助推廣內容誠實揭露。

examples.en: Taiwan promotes digital transformation across various public sectors.
examples.zh: 台灣積極推動各公共領域的數位化轉型。

examples.en: Digital cameras have largely replaced traditional film rolls for photography.
examples.zh: 數位數位相機在攝影領域已大幅取代了傳統底片膠卷。

examples.en: Developing solid digital literacy skills is crucial for contemporary careers.
examples.zh: 培養扎實的數位素養能力對於現代職場生涯至關重要。

examples.en: High-speed fiber-optic internet is widely accessible across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 光纖寬頻高速網路在全台灣各地都非常普及。

examples.en: The internet revolutionized how humanity communicates and accesses information.
examples.zh: 網際網路徹底革新了人類溝通與獲取資訊的方式。

examples.en: Make sure not to share personal financial secrets over unsecured public internet networks.
examples.zh: 請確保切勿在未加密的不安全公共網路上透露個人財務機密。

examples.en: Students can take interactive English quizzes online anytime.
examples.zh: 學生們隨時都可以在線上進行互動式英語測驗。

examples.en: The hotel booking system is currently down, but it will come back online shortly.
examples.zh: 飯店訂房系統目前正在維護，但很快就會重新恢復連線上線。

examples.en: Online fraud has become increasingly sophisticated, requiring enhanced consumer vigilance.
examples.zh: 線上網路詐騙手法日益精巧複雜，需要消費者提高防範警覺。
